sections.body: A $100M contract to build and operate a hydrofoil network across the Maldives. Ten vessels delivered. More than ten thousand operational hours across US and international waters.

sections.body: Foilborne, the hull never slams. No wake at speed. Near-silent, all-electric — quiet enough to take a call, smooth enough to open a laptop.

sections.body: The Quanta-D — our effector-equipped N30 demonstrator — ran real mission profiles in front of U.S. special operations evaluators at USSOCOM's Technical Experimentation 26-3, following demonstrations at Sea-Air-Space and SOF Week.
